titulo_fr: Une synthèse multi-documents : Observer les formes
titulo_es: Synthesis of various documents: Vocabulary and forms
intro: Resolves an integrated reading with information documents, an opinion and a subject data. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Resolves an integrated reading with information documents, an opinion and a subject data. It distinguishes statements, evidence and reservations; it attributes each data to its source before making a conclusion.
Point of attention: Synthetize without deleting the reservations: it separates the decided, the proposed and what depends on a subsequent evaluation. In this fragment, «réserve» means «reservation».

frases.fr: La note technique prévoit une fermeture partielle de six mois et recommande de maintenir un accès aux quais.
frases.es: La nota técnica prevé un cierre parcial de seis meses y recomienda mantener el acceso a los andenes.
frases.en: The technical note provides for a partial closure of six months and recommends that access to the platforms be maintained.

frases.fr: Une association de voyageurs soutient le projet, tout en demandant une solution pour les personnes à mobilité réduite.
frases.es: Una asociación de viajeros apoya el proyecto, pero pide una solución para las personas con movilidad reducida.
frases.en: A passenger association supports the project, but calls for a solution for people with reduced mobility.

frases.fr: Le financement est annoncé sous réserve d'une évaluation des coûts, qui sera publiée avant la fin de l'année.
frases.es: La financiación se anuncia sujeta a una evaluación de costes que se publicará antes de fin de año.
frases.en: The funding is announced subject to a cost assessment to be published before the end of the year.
